manual_engine_source_verified.note: MANUALLY ENGINE-SOURCE-VERIFIED. This half is NOT produced by hns_route.py and is not claimed to be. It decides the edges the analyzer reports as undecided from map data, and it records the script-command transitions an analyzer without a call graph cannot resolve. Every verdict carries the exact source that supports it. It is machine-checked in two ways: `hns_route.py inventory --check` fails if any undecided edge has no verdict here or if a verdict contradicts the tool-derived half, and `HnsLocationRuntimeEvidenceTest` asserts the same partition from the Kotlin suite.

reachability_from_an_early_legal_save.start: the issue #1 progression chain's furthest accepted checkpoint (Azalea Town area, two Johto badges, three party members)
reachability_from_an_early_legal_save.method: flood fill over all 560 H&S maps using the engine's warp and connection predicates (surf/waterfall HM gates read from src/field_move.c IsFieldMoveUnlocked_Surf / _Waterfall), at three assumption levels
evidence: no Surf and no Waterfall: 161 maps reached, ZERO cross-region edges
Surf without Waterfall: 169 maps reached, ZERO cross-region edges
Surf and Waterfall: 342 maps reached, which is where the first cross-region edges appear
Surf is mandatory and needs FLAG_BADGE04_GET: both the New Bark Town east edge (x=29, rows 11-14) and the Route 27 west edge (x=0, rows 22-25) are MB_OCEAN_WATER

Waterfall is mandatory and needs FLAG_BADGE08_GET: Tohjo Falls Cavern's west component joins its centre and east rooms only through the MB_WATERFALL column x=29-34, rows 12-17, and Route 27's east half is reachable no other way
even with Surf and Waterfall, ReceptionGate's (11,14) trigger requires VAR_ECRUTEAK_CITY_THEATER >= 8, set only by TinTower_RoofDay_hns (Ho-Oh) or WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_hns (Lugia)

Fly is not a shortcut: of every sMapHealLocations entry exactly one is cross-region (MAPSEC_ROCKET_HIDEOUT_HNS -> Pallet Town with HEAL_LOCATION_NONE, hence unusable), and every CANFLY city is gated by its own FLAG_VISITED_*, set only by physically entering
neither the tool-derived inventory nor the manual script audit finds any Alola <-> Johto transition
Alola links only to Kanto: MelemeleIsle_hns -> Route13_hns with no gate, and the reverse gated by checkitem ITEM_STRANGE_SOUVENIR, an item sold in the Kanto shop MtMoon_Shop_hns
